
# Bike rentals data info: https://divvybikes.com/system-data
# URL for the bike rentals data: https://divvy-tripdata.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html

```{r}
prepare_data_files <- function() {
  # Create a directory to store the data files
  dest_dir <- "CD705-R/Research/Bike_Rentals/data"
  dir.create(dest_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

  tmp_zip_file <- paste0(dest_dir, "/bike_rentals.zip")

  # Download the bike rentals data file
  download.file("https://divvy-tripdata.s3.amazonaws.com/202004-divvy-tripdata.zip", destfile = tmp_zip_file, mode = "wb")
  unzip(tmp_zip_file, exdir = dest_dir)
  file.remove(tmp_zip_file)
}

prepare_data_files()
```

```{r}

# Read the bike rentals data into a data frame
bike_rentals <- read.csv("CD705-R/Research/Bike_Rentals/data/202004-divvy-tripdata.csv")

# Display the first few rows of the data frame
head(bike_rentals)

# Store the GPS coordinates of the bike stations in a separate data frame
bike_stations <- unique(bike_rentals[, c("start_station_name", "start_lat", "start_lng")])
colnames(bike_stations) <- c("station_name", "latitude", "longitude")

# Make a map of the bike stations using the leaflet package
library(leaflet)
leaflet(data = bike_stations) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude, popup = ~station_name, radius = 5, color = "blue", fillOpacity = 0.7)

```
